$comment: Rusty IDD project-layer settings (layered on top of the user-global Claude config). SessionStart auto-invokes the Rusty IDD front door (rusty-idd next) so the computed next-step imperative is presented automatically — see .claude/rusty-idd-adapter.md and ADR-0015. This .claude dir is a THIN ADAPTER (ADR-0010); the workflow lives in the engine.

hooks.command: sh -lc 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; exec cargo run --quiet --manifest-path "$root/Cargo.toml" --bin rusty-idd -- next --base "$root"'
